decisions.reason: The product was only mentioned on the website, so public commitment is lower, but sunk development costs and the recent launch still make dropping unlikely.
A dedicated website page signals a stronger public commitment and investment, making withdrawal less likely under escalation of commitment.
The active launch announcement ('Newly arrived') and dedicated page reflect high public commitment, so the firm will likely persist despite any early disappointments.
As with A, only a website mention indicates modest visibility, but the firm has already invested and will tend to justify the launch by keeping it.
The marine HMI searchlight has incurred development costs and is publicly listed, so escalation predicts persistence despite only moderate visibility.
Like the other mentioned-only products, the marine searchlight has lower public visibility but still benefits from sunk-cost commitment, so it is unlikely to be dropped.
